rules.name: pill-language
rules.summary: Buttons are pills; no square primary buttons anywhere.
rules.why: Observed live (radius = half height) and reaffirmed at Gate 2.
rules.fix: Replace square corners on buttons with the pill radius.

rules.name: palette-discipline
rules.summary: Colours come from the wink palette only: Cavendish Yellow, Peppercorn ink, Parsnip, Ochre, Kale, #BF4055 error.
